description: Runs synchronously after DOM mutations and before paint. Use it to measure layout and adjust the UI without flicker.
The moment the browser draws the frame. `useEffect` usually runs after it; `useLayoutEffect` before it.
Profiler phase for an update scheduled during a commit, such as `setState` inside a layout effect.
Fires before layout effects; meant for CSS-in-JS libraries to inject styles.
DOM API returning an element's size and position relative to the viewport.
